text: DSH Preset Library 是面向 DSH Web 的 agent preset 管理插件，在设置页提供独立的预设资料库。它从 DSH 读取 preset 清单，并让用户搜索、按名称或状态排序、用标签筛选和分组浏览。用户可以创建彩色标签、批量添加或移除标签、设置预设间的单层父子关联，也能切换新任务默认预设及启用或停用 bundle。标签和关联元数据保存到本机文件；不需要额外 API Key。

DSH Preset Library adds a preset manager to DSH Web Settings. Search and sort presets, filter by status or tags, and browse grid, list, or grouped views. Create tags, bulk-edit them, link presets in one-level families, choose a default, and toggle bundles. Metadata stays local; no API key is needed.

I want to organize related presets into parent and child groups.
DSH Preset Library 的功能「搜索与筛选」：按名称、ID、描述或标签文本搜索预设，并按默认、损坏、未标记状态筛选，再按名称、ID 或状态排序。
DSH Preset Library 的功能「标签管理」：创建、改名、换色或删除标签，并可对选中的多个预设批量添加、替换或移除标签。
DSH Preset Library 的功能「多视图浏览」：以网格、列表或按标签分组的布局查看预设；分组和父子系列可折叠。
DSH Preset Library 的功能「默认预设与 bundle」：从预设清单选择新任务默认项，并查看 bundle 与插件清单、切换 bundle 启用状态。

dsh-preset-library README · DSH Preset Library：Search, tag and organize a large DeepSeek Harness preset collection without rewriting the presets themselves.

Features include compact grid/list/grouped views, bulk tags, status filters, and one-level parent/child affiliations. Metadata is versioned, validated and saved atomically with revision conflict checks. The interface supports English and Chinese.

dsh-preset-library README · Install：Requires **Node.js 24**, npm and a working **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5** Web profile.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LiweiDonVee/dsh-preset-library.git
cd dsh-preset-library
npm ci
npm run check

Keep the clone in place if the package manager installs it as a local link. Restart the host after installation and use its printed login URL. Open **Settings → Preset Library**.

dsh-preset-library README · Install：The metadata file is `$DSH_HOME/preset-library.json`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/preset-library.json`. Back up this file before bulk changes. Preset declarations are read-only in this plugin. The new-task default uses DSH's volatile `selectedDefault` setting, and bundle inventory uses DSH's plugin manager APIs.

Remove with:

```sh
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.5 plugin --profile web remove dsh-preset-library
```

Restart DSH afterward. Uninstall does not erase tag metadata.

dsh-preset-library README · Development and limits：`npm run check` runs deterministic regression tests and rebuilds the host/client bundles. The plugin uses `agentPresets.list`, volatile default selection through `settings.update('agent-preset-registry', { selectedDefault })`, `pluginManager.listBundles`/`setBundleEnabled`, and `pluginInventory.list`. CI tests Windows and Linux.

dsh-preset-library README · Development and limits：The metadata API deliberately accepts only loopback requests, even if the host itself is exposed remotely. Relationships support one parent level. This preview plugin depends on DSH's evolving Remote/slot contracts.

Original community implementation; no affiliation with DeepSeek AI. MIT license; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Icons and React are imported from the host, not copied into this package.
